outcome: successful vaginal delivery within 72 hours of induction
maternal complications (psychological upset, fever, need for blood transfusion)
cohort: 128 patients with intrauterine fetal death (IUFD) admitted to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Chattogram Medical College Hospital (CMCH), Bangladesh, from January 2021 to June 2021.
finding: Mifepristone successfully induced labor as a primary method in 69.5% of cases for IUFD termination, with successful delivery within 72 hours occurring in 61.7% of cases.
mod_finding: Mifepristone was found to be very effective and safe in achieving vaginal delivery for the termination of IUFD, though some cases required augmentation with oxytocin and/or misoprostol.
gest_age: 40.6% of participants had a gestational age between 24-32 weeks
